175  /** Transforms the value to the SQL statement lower(val). */
176  protected String toSQLLower(String val) {
177    return "lower(" + val + ")";
178  }
179
180  protected String toSQLField(S param, boolean matchCase) {
181    return Optional.ofNullable(term(param))
182        .map(
183            term -> {
184              String sqlCol = sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term);
185              if (String.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())
186                  && (param != OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOMETRY)
187                  && (param != OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME)
188                  && !matchCase) {
189                return toSQLLower(sqlCol);
190              }
191              return sqlCol;
192            })
193        .orElseThrow(
194            () ->
195                // QueryBuildingException requires an underlying exception
196                new IllegalArgumentException(
197                    "Search parameter " + param.type().getName() + "." + param + " is not mapped"));
198  }
199
200  /**
201   * Allow support for querying the denormalized extension.
202   *
203   * @param param
204   * @param matchCase
205   * @return
206   */
207  protected String toSQLDenormField(S param, boolean matchCase) {
208    return Optional.ofNullable(term(param))
209        .map(
210            term -> {
211              if (term instanceof DwcTerm) {
212                DwcTerm dwcTerm = (DwcTerm) term;
213                String field = "Denorm.parents." + dwcTerm.simpleName();
214                if (String.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())
215                    && !"GEOMETRY".equals(param.name())
216                    && !matchCase) {
217                  return toSQLLower(field);
218                }
219                return field;
220              }
221              return null;
222            })
223        .orElseThrow(
224            () ->
225                // QueryBuildingException requires an underlying exception
226                new IllegalArgumentException(
227                    "Search parameter " + param + " is not mapped to Hive"));
228  }

230  /**
231   * Converts a value to the form expected by Hive based on the SearchParameter. Most values pass by
232   * unaltered. Quotes are added for values that need to be quoted, escaping any existing quotes.
233   *
234   * @param param the type of parameter defining the expected type
235   * @param value the original query value
236   * @return the converted value expected by Hive
237   */
238  protected String toSQLValue(S param, String value, boolean matchCase) {
239    if (Enum.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
240      // all enum parameters are uppercase
241      return '\'' + value.toUpperCase() + '\'';
242    }
243
244    if (Date.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
245      // use longs for timestamps expressed as ISO dates
246      LocalDate ld = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDate(value);
247      Instant i = ld.atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant();
248      if (isInterpretedUtcDateMilliseconds(term(param))) {
249        return String.valueOf(i.toEpochMilli());
250      } else {
251        return String.valueOf(i.getEpochSecond());
252      }
253
254    } else if (Number.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())
255        || Boolean.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
256      // do not quote numbers
257      return value;
258
259    } else {
260      // quote value, escape existing quotes
261      String strVal = '\'' + value.replaceAll("'", "\\\\'") + '\'';
262      if (String.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())
263          && !"GEOMETRY".equals(param.name())
264          && OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME != param
265          && !matchCase) {
266        return toSQLLower(strVal);
267      }
268      return strVal;
269    }
270  }

272  /**
273   * Translates a valid {@link org.gbif.api.model.occurrence.Download} object and translates it into
274   * a strings that can be used as the <em>WHERE</em> clause for a SQL (hive or spark) download.
275   *
276   * @param predicate to translate
277   * @return WHERE clause
278   */
279  public String buildQuery(Predicate predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
280    String query = ALL_QUERY;
281    if (predicate != null) { // null predicate means a SELECT ALL
282      builder = new StringBuilder();
283      visit(predicate);
284      query = builder.toString();
285    }
286
287    // Set to null to prevent old StringBuilders hanging around in case this class is reused
288    // somewhere else
289    builder = null;
290    return query;
291  }

293  public void visit(ConjunctionPredicate predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
294    visitCompoundPredicate(predicate, CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
295  }
296
297  public void visit(DisjunctionPredicate predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
298    // See if this disjunction can be simplified into an IN predicate, which is much faster.
299    // We could overcomplicate this:
300    //   A=1 OR A=2 OR B=3 OR B=4 OR C>5 → A IN(1,2) OR B IN (3,4) OR C>5
301    // but that's a very unusual query for us, so we just check for
302    // - EqualsPredicates everywhere
303    // - on the same search parameter.
304
305    boolean useIn = true;
306    Boolean matchCase = null;
307    List<String> values = new ArrayList<>();
308    S parameter = null;
309    String checklistsKey = null;
310
311    for (Predicate subPredicate : predicate.getPredicates()) {
312      if (subPredicate instanceof EqualsPredicate) {
313        EqualsPredicate<S> equalsSubPredicate = (EqualsPredicate<S>) subPredicate;
314        if (parameter == null) {
315          parameter = equalsSubPredicate.getKey();
316          matchCase = equalsSubPredicate.isMatchCase();
317          checklistsKey = getChecklistKey(equalsSubPredicate.getChecklistKey());
318        } else if (parameter != equalsSubPredicate.getKey()
319            || matchCase != equalsSubPredicate.isMatchCase()
320            || !Objects.equals(
321                checklistsKey, getChecklistKey(equalsSubPredicate.getChecklistKey()))) {
322          useIn = false;
323          break;
324        }
325        values.add(equalsSubPredicate.getValue());
326      } else {
327        useIn = false;
328        break;
329      }
330    }
331
332    if (useIn && OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME != parameter) {
333      visit(new InPredicate<>(parameter, values, matchCase, checklistsKey));
334    } else {
335      visitCompoundPredicate(predicate, DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
336    }
337  }

339  public Function<Term, String> getArrayFn() {
340    return t -> "stringArrayContains(" + sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(t) + ",'%s',%b)";
341  }
342
343  public Function<Term, String> getArrayLikeFn() {
344    return t -> "stringArrayLike(" + sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(t) + ",'%s',%b)";
345  }
346
347  /** Supports all parameters incl taxonKey expansion for higher taxa. */
348  public void visit(EqualsPredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
349    if (isHumboldtTaxonParameter(predicate.getKey())) {
350      appendHumboldtTaxonFilter(predicate);
351    } else if (TAXON_SEARCH_PARAMETERS.contains(predicate.getKey())) {
352      appendTaxonomicFilter(predicate);
353    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.GADM_GID) {
354      appendGadmFilterList(GADM_GIDS, predicate.getValue());
355    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.MEDIA_TYPE) {
356      Optional.ofNullable(VocabularyUtils.lookupEnum(predicate.getValue(), MediaType.class))
357          .ifPresent(
358              mediaType ->
359                  builder.append(
360                      String.format(
361                          getArrayFn().apply(GbifTerm.mediaType), mediaType.name(), true)));
362    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE) {
363      builder.append(
364          String.format(
365              getArrayFn().apply(GbifTerm.issue), predicate.getValue().toUpperCase(), true));
366    } else if (isSQLArray(predicate.getKey())) {
367      builder.append(
368          String.format(
369              getArrayFn().apply(sqlTermsMapper.getTermArray(predicate.getKey())),
370              predicate.getValue().replaceAll("'", "\\\\'"),
371              predicate.isMatchCase()));
372    } else if (sqlTermsMapper.isDenormedTerm(predicate.getKey())) {
373      builder
374          .append("(")
375          .append("(")
376          .append(toSQLField(predicate.getKey(), predicate.isMatchCase()))
377          .append(EQUALS_OPERATOR)
378          .append(toSQLValue(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue(), predicate.isMatchCase()))
379          .append(") OR (")
380          .append("stringArrayContains(")
381          .append(toSQLDenormField(predicate.getKey(), true))
382          .append(",")
383          .append(toSQLValue(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue(), true))
384          .append("))")
385          .append(")");
386    } else if (SQLColumnsUtils.isVocabulary(term(predicate.getKey()))) {
387      builder.append(
388          String.format(getArrayFn().apply(term(predicate.getKey())), predicate.getValue(), false));
389    } else if (Date.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
390      // Dates may contain a range even for an EqualsPredicate (e.g. "2000" or "2000-02")
391      // The user's query value is inclusive, but the parsed dateRange is exclusive of the
392      // upperBound to allow including the day itself.
393      //
394      // I.e. a predicate value 2000/2005-03 gives a dateRange [2000-01-01,2005-04-01)
395      Range<LocalDate> dateRange = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDateRange(predicate.getValue());
396
397      if (dateRange.hasLowerBound() || dateRange.hasUpperBound()) {
398        builder.append('(');
399        if (dateRange.hasLowerBound()) {
400          visitSimplePredicate(
401              predicate,
402              GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR,
403              ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.lowerEndpoint()));
404          if (dateRange.hasUpperBound()) {
405            builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
406          }
407        }
408        if (dateRange.hasUpperBound()) {
409          visitSimplePredicate(
410              predicate, LESS_THAN_OPERATOR, ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.upperEndpoint()));
411        }
412        builder.append(')');
413      }
414    } else if (IsoDateInterval.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
415      // Dates may contain a range even for an EqualsPredicate (e.g. "2000" or "2000-02")
416      // The user's query value is inclusive, but the parsed dateRange is exclusive of the
417      // upperBound to allow including the day itself.
418      //
419      // I.e. a predicate value 2000/2005-03 gives a dateRange [2000-01-01,2005-04-01)
420      Range<LocalDate> dateRange = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDateRange(predicate.getValue());
421
422      if (dateRange.hasLowerBound() || dateRange.hasUpperBound()) {
423        // all the stuff here
424        builder.append('(');
425        if (dateRange.hasLowerBound()) {
426          SimplePredicate predicateGte =
427              new EqualsPredicate<>(
428                  InternalOccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE_GTE,
429                  predicate.getValue(),
430                  predicate.isMatchCase());
431          visitSimplePredicate(
432              predicateGte,
433              GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR,
434              ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.lowerEndpoint()));
435          if (dateRange.hasUpperBound()) {
436            builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
437          }
438        }
439        if (dateRange.hasUpperBound()) {
440          SimplePredicate predicateLte =
441              new EqualsPredicate<>(
442                  InternalOccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE_LTE,
443                  predicate.getValue(),
444                  predicate.isMatchCase());
445          visitSimplePredicate(
446              predicateLte,
447              LESS_THAN_OPERATOR,
448              ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.upperEndpoint()));
449        }
450        builder.append(')');
451      }
452    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME) {
453      if (SearchTypeValidator.isNumericRange(predicate.getValue())) {
454        Range<Double> range = SearchTypeValidator.parseDecimalRange(predicate.getValue());
455        if (range.hasLowerBound()) {
456          builder
457              .append(GEOLOGICAL_TIME_GT_COLUMN)
458              .append(GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
459              .append(range.lowerEndpoint());
460        }
461        if (range.hasUpperBound()) {
462          if (range.hasLowerBound()) {
463            builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
464          }
465          builder
466              .append(GEOLOGICAL_TIME_LTE_COLUMN)
467              .append(LESS_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
468              .append(range.upperEndpoint());
469        }
470      } else {
471        builder
472            .append(GEOLOGICAL_TIME_GT_COLUMN)
473            .append(GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
474            .append(predicate.getValue())
475            .append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR)
476            .append(GEOLOGICAL_TIME_LTE_COLUMN)
477            .append(LESS_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
478            .append(predicate.getValue());
479      }
480    } else {
481      visitSimplePredicate(predicate, EQUALS_OPERATOR);
482    }
483  }
484
485  private void appendTaxonomicFilter(EqualsPredicate<S> predicate) {
486
487    // For TAXON_KEY use the taxonKeys column - this will support taxon keys at any rank
488    if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.TAXON_KEY) {
489      builder
490          .append('(')
491          .append(
492              String.format(
493                  "stringArrayContains(%s, '%s', true)",
494                  resolveTaxonColumnName("taxonkeys", predicate.getChecklistKey()),
495                  predicate.getValue()))
496          .append(')');
497    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.TAXONOMIC_ISSUE) {
498      // special case for taxonomic issues, which are stored in an ARRAY, the other taxon fields are
499      // STRING
500      builder
501          .append('(')
502          .append(
503              String.format(
504                  "stringArrayContains(%s, '%s', true)",
505                  resolveTaxonColumnName("taxonomicissue", predicate.getChecklistKey()),
506                  predicate.getValue()))
507          .append(')');
508    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.IUCN_RED_LIST_CATEGORY) {
509      // special case for IUCN to make case insensitive for backwards compatibility
510      String columnName = sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term(predicate.getKey()));
511      builder
512          .append("lower(" + resolveTaxonColumnName(columnName, predicate.getChecklistKey()) + ")")
513          .append(EQUALS_OPERATOR)
514          .append("lower('")
515          .append(predicate.getValue())
516          .append("')");
517    } else {
518      String columnName = sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term(predicate.getKey()));
519      String resolvedColumn = resolveTaxonColumnName(columnName, predicate.getChecklistKey());
520      String escapedValue = predicate.getValue().replaceAll("'", "\\\\'");
521      if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.SCIENTIFIC_NAME
522          && !predicate.isMatchCase()) {
523        builder
524            .append(toSQLLower(resolvedColumn))
525            .append(EQUALS_OPERATOR)
526            .append(toSQLLower("'" + escapedValue + "'"));
527      } else {
528        builder
529            .append(resolvedColumn)
530            .append(EQUALS_OPERATOR)
531            .append('\'')
532            .append(escapedValue)
533            .append('\'');
534      }
535    }
536  }

538  /**
539   * Resolves the column name for a taxon field based on the checklist key. If the checklist key is
540   * not the denormalised taxonomy, it will prepend the appropriate nested struct prefix to the
541   * column name.
542   *
543   * @param sqlField the SQL field name to resolve
544   * @param suppliedChecklistKey the checklist key provided in the predicate, may be null
545   * @return the resolved column name with the appropriate prefix if necessary
546   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the checklist key is not mapped to a nested struct in the
547   *     table
548   */
549  public String resolveTaxonColumnName(String sqlField, String suppliedChecklistKey) {
550    String queryFieldPrefix = "";
551    String checklistKey = getChecklistKey(suppliedChecklistKey);
552    if (!denormalisedTaxonomy.equals(checklistKey)) {
553      if (checklistNestedStructMap.containsKey(checklistKey)) {
554        queryFieldPrefix =
555            disambiguationTable + "." + checklistNestedStructMap.get(checklistKey) + ".";
556      } else {
557        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
558            "Checklist key "
559                + checklistKey
560                + " is not mapped to a nested struct in the table. Please add it to the checklistNestedStructMap.");
561      }
562    }
563    return queryFieldPrefix + sqlField;
564  }

566  public void visit(GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
567    if (Date.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
568      // Where the date is a range, consider the "OrEquals" to mean including the whole range.
569      // "2000" includes all of 2000.
570      Range<LocalDate> dateRange = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDateRange(predicate.getValue());
571      visitSimplePredicate(
572          predicate,
573          GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR,
574          ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.lowerEndpoint()));
575    } else if (IsoDateInterval.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
576      // Where the date is a range, consider the "OrEquals" to mean including the whole range.
577      // "2000" includes all of 2000.
578      Range<LocalDate> dateRange = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDateRange(predicate.getValue());
579      SimplePredicate predicateLte =
580          new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(
581              InternalOccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE_LTE, predicate.getValue());
582      visitSimplePredicate(
583          predicateLte,
584          GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR,
585          ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.lowerEndpoint()));
586    } else if (OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME == predicate.getKey()) {
587      builder
588          .append(GEOLOGICAL_TIME_GT_COLUMN)
589          .append(GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
590          .append(predicate.getValue());
591    } else {
592      visitSimplePredicate(predicate, GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR);
593    }
594  }

596  public void visit(GreaterThanPredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
597    if (Date.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
598      // Where the date is a range, consider the lack of "OrEquals" to mean excluding the whole
599      // range.
600      // "2000" excludes all of 2000, so the earliest date is 2001-01-01.
601      Range<LocalDate> dateRange = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDateRange(predicate.getValue());
602      visitSimplePredicate(
603          predicate,
604          GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR,
605          ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.upperEndpoint()));
606    } else if (IsoDateInterval.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
607      // Where the date is a range, consider the lack of "OrEquals" to mean excluding the whole
608      // range.
609      // "2000" excludes all of 2000, so the earliest date is 2001-01-01.
610      Range<LocalDate> dateRange = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDateRange(predicate.getValue());
611      SimplePredicate predicateLte =
612          new GreaterThanPredicate<>(
613              InternalOccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE_LTE, predicate.getValue());
614      visitSimplePredicate(
615          predicateLte,
616          GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR,
617          ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.upperEndpoint()));
618
619    } else if (OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME == predicate.getKey()) {
620      builder
621          .append(GEOLOGICAL_TIME_LTE_COLUMN)
622          .append(GREATER_THAN_OPERATOR)
623          .append(predicate.getValue());
624    } else {
625      visitSimplePredicate(predicate, GREATER_THAN_OPERATOR);
626    }
627  }

683  public void visit(RangePredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
684    builder.append("((");
685
686    if (!Objects.isNull(predicate.getValue().getGte())) {
687      visitSimplePredicate(
688          new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue().getGte()),
689          GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR);
690    } else {
691      visitSimplePredicate(
692          new LessThanPredicate<>(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue().getGt()),
693          GREATER_THAN_OPERATOR);
694    }
695
696    builder.append(")");
697    builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
698    builder.append("(");
699
700    if (!Objects.isNull(predicate.getValue().getLte())) {
701      visitSimplePredicate(
702          new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue().getLte()),
703          LESS_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR);
704    } else {
705      visitSimplePredicate(
706          new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue().getLt()),
707          LESS_THAN_OPERATOR);
708    }
709    builder.append("))");
710  }

712  /*
713   * For large disjunctions, IN predicates are around 3× faster than a perfectly balanced tree of
714   * OR predicates, and around 2× faster than a fairly flat OR query.
715   *
716   * With Hive 1.3.0, balancing OR queries should be internal to Hive:
717   *   https://jira.apache.org/jira/browse/HIVE-11398
718   * but it is probably still better to use an IN, which uses a hash table lookup internally:
719   *   https://jira.apache.org/jira/browse/HIVE-11415#comment-14651085
720   */
721  public void visit(InPredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
722    log.info("InPredicate " + predicate);
723
724    boolean isMatchCase = Optional.ofNullable(predicate.isMatchCase()).orElse(Boolean.FALSE);
725
726    if (isSQLArray(predicate.getKey()) || SQLColumnsUtils.isVocabulary(term(predicate.getKey()))) {
727      // Array values must be converted to ORs.
728      builder.append('(');
729      Iterator<String> iterator = predicate.getValues().iterator();
730      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
731        // Use the equals predicate to get the behaviour for array.
732        visit(new EqualsPredicate<S>(predicate.getKey(), iterator.next(), isMatchCase));
733        if (iterator.hasNext()) {
734          builder.append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
735        }
736      }
737      builder.append(')');
738    } else if (isHumboldtTaxonParameter(predicate.getKey())) {
739      appendHumboldtTaxonFilter(predicate);
740    } else if (TAXON_KEY_SEARCH_PARAMETERS.contains(predicate.getKey())) {
741      appendTaxonKeyArrayFilter(predicate);
742    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.TAXONOMIC_ISSUE) {
743      appendTaxonomicArrayFilter(predicate, "taxonomicissue");
744    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.TAXONOMIC_STATUS) {
745      appendTaxonomicSingleValueFilter(predicate, "taxonomicstatus");
746    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.IUCN_RED_LIST_CATEGORY) {
747      appendTaxonomicSingleValueFilterCaseInsensitive(predicate, "iucnredlistcategory");
748    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.GADM_GID) {
749      // GADM GIDs must be expanded into a disjunction of in predicates
750      appendGadmGidFilter(predicate.getValues());
751    } else if ("EVENT_DATE".equals(predicate.getKey().name())) {
752      // Event dates must be expanded into a disjunction of conjunction predicates (of comparisons)
753      builder.append('(');
754      Iterator<String> iterator = predicate.getValues().iterator();
755      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
756        // Use the equals predicate to get the behaviour for event dates.
757        visit(new EqualsPredicate<S>(predicate.getKey(), iterator.next(), isMatchCase));
758        if (iterator.hasNext()) {
759          builder.append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
760        }
761      }
762      builder.append(')');
763
764    } else if (OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME == predicate.getKey()) {
765      List<Predicate> allPredicates =
766          predicate.getValues().stream()
767              .map(v -> new EqualsPredicate<>(predicate.getKey(), v, false))
768              .collect(Collectors.toList());
769      visit(new DisjunctionPredicate(allPredicates));
770    } else {
771      builder
772          .append('(')
773          .append(toSQLField(predicate.getKey(), isMatchCase))
774          .append(IN_OPERATOR)
775          .append('(');
776      Iterator<String> iterator = predicate.getValues().iterator();
777      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
778        builder.append(toSQLValue(predicate.getKey(), iterator.next(), isMatchCase));
779        if (iterator.hasNext()) {
780          builder.append(", ");
781        }
782      }
783      builder.append(")");
784
785      // this block can be removed in future if we don't need a denormalized
786      // AVRO extension
787      if (sqlTermsMapper.isDenormedTerm(predicate.getKey())) {
788        builder.append(" OR ").append('(');
789
790        Iterator<String> iterator2 = predicate.getValues().iterator();
791        while (iterator2.hasNext()) {
792          builder
793              .append('(')
794              .append("array_contains(")
795              .append(toSQLDenormField(predicate.getKey(), true))
796              .append(',')
797              .append(toSQLValue(predicate.getKey(), iterator2.next(), true))
798              .append(')')
799              .append(')');
800          if (iterator2.hasNext()) {
801            builder.append(" OR ");
802          }
803        }
804        builder.append(")");
805      }
806      builder.append(")");
807    }
808  }

810  public void visit(LikePredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
811    if (sqlTermsMapper.isArray(predicate.getKey())) {
812      builder.append(
813          String.format(
814              getArrayLikeFn().apply(sqlTermsMapper.getTermArray(predicate.getKey())),
815              predicate.getValue().replaceAll("'", "\\\\'"),
816              predicate.isMatchCase()));
817    } else {
818      // Replace % → \% and _ → \_
819      // Then replace * → % and ? → _
820      LikePredicate<S> likePredicate =
821          new LikePredicate<>(
822              predicate.getKey(),
823              predicate
824                  .getValue()
825                  .replace("%", "\\%")
826                  .replace("_", "\\_")
827                  .replace('*', '%')
828                  .replace('?', '_'),
829              predicate.getChecklistKey(),
830              predicate.isMatchCase());
831
832      if (TAXON_SEARCH_PARAMETERS.contains(predicate.getKey())) {
833
834        String columnName = sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term(likePredicate.getKey()));
835        String resolvedColumn = resolveTaxonColumnName(columnName, likePredicate.getChecklistKey());
836        if (likePredicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.SCIENTIFIC_NAME
837            && !predicate.isMatchCase()) {
838          builder
839              .append(toSQLLower(resolvedColumn))
840              .append(LIKE_OPERATOR)
841              .append(
842                  toSQLValue(
843                      likePredicate.getKey(),
844                      likePredicate.getValue(),
845                      likePredicate.isMatchCase()));
846        } else {
847          builder
848              .append(resolvedColumn)
849              .append(LIKE_OPERATOR)
850              .append(
851                  toSQLValue(
852                      likePredicate.getKey(),
853                      likePredicate.getValue(),
854                      likePredicate.isMatchCase()));
855        }
856      } else {
857        visitSimplePredicate(likePredicate, LIKE_OPERATOR);
858      }
859    }
860  }

862  public void visit(NotPredicate predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
863    builder.append(NOT_OPERATOR);
864    visit(predicate.getPredicate());
865  }

867  public void visit(IsNotNullPredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
868    if (isHumboldtTaxonParameter(predicate.getParameter())) {
869      appendHumboldtTaxonUnary(
870          getChecklistKey(predicate.getChecklistKey()), IS_NOT_NULL_ARRAY_OPERATOR);
871    } else if (isSQLArray(predicate.getParameter())
872        || SQLColumnsUtils.isVocabulary(term(predicate.getParameter()))) {
873      builder.append(
874          String.format(IS_NOT_NULL_ARRAY_OPERATOR, toSQLField(predicate.getParameter(), true)));
875    } else if (TAXON_SEARCH_PARAMETERS.contains(predicate.getParameter())) {
876      appendTaxonKeyIsNotNull(predicate);
877    } else if (predicate.getParameter() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.GADM_GID) {
878      appendUnaryList(GADM_GIDS, IS_NOT_NULL_OPERATOR);
879    } else {
880      // matchCase: Avoid adding an unnecessary "lower()" when just testing for null.
881      builder.append(toSQLField(predicate.getParameter(), true));
882      builder.append(IS_NOT_NULL_OPERATOR);
883    }
884  }

886  public void visit(IsNullPredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
887    if (TAXON_SEARCH_PARAMETERS.contains(predicate.getParameter())) {
888      appendTaxonKeyNull(predicate);
889    } else if (isHumboldtTaxonParameter(predicate.getParameter())) {
890      appendHumboldtTaxonUnary(
891          getChecklistKey(predicate.getChecklistKey()), IS_NULL_ARRAY_OPERATOR);
892    } else if (predicate.getParameter() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.GADM_GID) {
893      appendUnaryList(GADM_GIDS, IS_NULL_OPERATOR);
894    } else {
895      // matchCase: Avoid adding an unnecessary "lower()" when just testing for null.
896      if (isSQLArray(predicate.getParameter())) {
897        builder.append(
898            String.format(IS_NULL_ARRAY_OPERATOR, toSQLField(predicate.getParameter(), true)));
899      } else {
900        builder.append(toSQLField(predicate.getParameter(), true));
901        builder.append(IS_NULL_OPERATOR);
902      }
903    }
904  }

906  /** Searches any of the NUB keys in Hive of any rank. */
907  private void appendTaxonKeyIsNotNull(IsNotNullPredicate<S> predicate) {
908    String sqlField = predicate.getParameter().name().replace("_", "").toLowerCase();
909    if (predicate.getParameter() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.TAXONOMIC_ISSUE) {
910      String taxonomicIssueColumn = resolveTaxonColumnName(sqlField, predicate.getChecklistKey());
911      builder.append(
912          String.format(
913              "%s IS NOT NULL OR size(%s) > 0", taxonomicIssueColumn, taxonomicIssueColumn));
914    } else {
915      builder.append(
916          String.format(
917              "%s IS NOT NULL", resolveTaxonColumnName(sqlField, predicate.getChecklistKey())));
918    }
919  }

936  public void visit(WithinPredicate within) throws QueryBuildingException {
937    JtsSpatialContextFactory spatialContextFactory = new JtsSpatialContextFactory();
938    spatialContextFactory.normWrapLongitude = true;
939    spatialContextFactory.srid = 4326;
940    spatialContextFactory.datelineRule = DatelineRule.ccwRect;
941
942    WKTReader reader =
943        new WKTReader(spatialContextFactory.newSpatialContext(), spatialContextFactory);
944
945    try {
946      // the geometry must be valid - it was validated in the predicates constructor
947      Shape geometry = reader.parse(within.getGeometry());
948
949      builder.append('(');
950      String withinGeometry;
951
952      // Add an additional filter to a bounding box around any shapes that aren't quadrilaterals, to
953      // speed up the query.
954      if (geometry instanceof JtsGeometry
955          && ((JtsGeometry) geometry).getGeom().getNumPoints() != 5) {
956        Geometry g = ((JtsGeometry) geometry).getGeom();
957        // Use the Spatial4J-fixed geometry; this is split into a multipolygon if it crosses the
958        // antimeridian.
959        withinGeometry = g.toText();
960
961        Rectangle bounds = geometry.getBoundingBox();
962        boundingBox(bounds);
963        builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
964
965        // A tool (R?) can generate hundreds of tiny areas spread across the globe, all in a single
966        // multipolygon.
967        // Add bounding boxes for these too.
968        // Example: https://www.gbif.org/occurrence/download/0187894-210914110416597
969        if (g instanceof MultiPolygon && g.getNumGeometries() > 2) {
970          builder.append("((");
971          for (int i = 0; i < g.getNumGeometries(); i++) {
972            if (i > 0) {
973              // Too many clauses exceeds Hive's query parsing stack.
974              if (i % 500 == 0) {
975                builder.append(')');
976                builder.append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
977                builder.append('(');
978              } else {
979                builder.append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
980              }
981            }
982            Geometry gi = g.getGeometryN(i);
983            Envelope env = gi.getEnvelopeInternal();
984            boundingBox(
985                new RectangleImpl(
986                    env.getMinX(),
987                    env.getMaxX(),
988                    env.getMinY(),
989                    env.getMaxY(),
990                    geometry.getContext()));
991          }
992          builder.append("))");
993          builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
994        }
995      } else {
996        withinGeometry = within.getGeometry();
997      }
998      builder
999          .append("contains('")
1000          .append(withinGeometry)
1001          .append("', ")
1002          .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLatitude))
1003          .append(", ")
1004          .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLongitude));
1005      // Without the "= TRUE", the expression may evaluate to TRUE or FALSE for all records,
1006      // depending
1007      // on the data format (ORC, Avro, Parquet, text) of the table (!).
1008      // We could not reproduce the issue on our test cluster, so it seems safest to include this.
1009      builder.append(") = TRUE").append(')');
1010    } catch (Exception e) {
1011      throw new QueryBuildingException(e);
1012    }
1013  }

1015  public void visit(GeoDistancePredicate geoDistance) throws QueryBuildingException {
1016    builder
1017        .append("(geoDistance(")
1018        .append(geoDistance.getGeoDistance().getLatitude())
1019        .append(", ")
1020        .append(geoDistance.getGeoDistance().getLongitude())
1021        .append(", '")
1022        .append(geoDistance.getGeoDistance().getDistance().toString())
1023        .append("', ")
1024        .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLatitude))
1025        .append(", ")
1026        .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLongitude))
1027        .append(") = TRUE)");
1028  }
1029
1030  /**
1031   * Given a bounding box, generates greater than / lesser than queries using decimalLatitude and
1032   * decimalLongitude to form a bounding box.
1033   */
1034  private void boundingBox(Rectangle bounds) {
1035    builder
1036        .append('(')
1037        // Latitude is easy:
1038        .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLatitude))
1039        .append(GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
1040        .append(bounds.getMinY())
1041        .append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR)
1042        .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLatitude))
1043        .append(LESS_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
1044        .append(bounds.getMaxY())
1045        .append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR)
1046
1047        // Longitude must take account of crossing the antimeridian:
1048        .append('(')
1049        .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLongitude))
1050        .append(GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
1051        .append(bounds.getMinX());
1052    if (bounds.getMinX() < bounds.getMaxX()) {
1053      builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
1054    } else {
1055      builder.append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
1056    }
1057    builder
1058        .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLongitude))
1059        .append(LESS_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
1060        .append(bounds.getMaxX())
1061        .append(')')
1062        .append(')');
1063  }
1064
1065  /**
1066   * Builds a list of predicates joined by 'op' statements. The final statement will look like this:
1067   *
1068   * <p>
1069   *
1070   * <pre>
1071   * ((predicate) op (predicate) ... op (predicate))
1072   * </pre>
1073   */
1074  public void visitCompoundPredicate(CompoundPredicate predicate, String op)
1075      throws QueryBuildingException {
1076    builder.append('(');
1077    Iterator<Predicate> iterator = predicate.getPredicates().iterator();
1078    while (iterator.hasNext()) {
1079      Predicate subPredicate = iterator.next();
1080      builder.append('(');
1081      visit(subPredicate);
1082      builder.append(')');
1083      if (iterator.hasNext()) {
1084        builder.append(op);
1085      }
1086    }
1087    builder.append(')');
1088  }
1089
1090  public void visitSimplePredicate(SimplePredicate<S> predicate, String op)
1091      throws QueryBuildingException {
1092    if (Number.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
1093      if (SearchTypeValidator.isNumericRange(predicate.getValue())) {
1094        if (Integer.class.equals(predicate.getKey().type())) {
1095          visit(
1096              toIntegerRangePredicate(
1097                  SearchTypeValidator.parseIntegerRange(predicate.getValue()), predicate.getKey()));
1098        } else {
1099          visit(
1100              toNumberRangePredicate(
1101                  SearchTypeValidator.parseDecimalRange(predicate.getValue()), predicate.getKey()));
1102        }
1103        return;
1104      }
1105    }
1106
1107    if (sqlTermsMapper.includeNullInPredicate(predicate)) {
1108      String column = sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLColumn(term(predicate.getKey()));
1109      builder
1110          .append('(')
1111          .append(toSQLField(predicate.getKey(), predicate.isMatchCase()))
1112          .append(op)
1113          .append(toSQLValue(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue(), predicate.isMatchCase()))
1114          .append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR)
1115          .append(
1116              isSQLArray(predicate.getKey())
1117                  ? String.format(IS_NOT_NULL_ARRAY_OPERATOR, column)
1118                  : column + IS_NULL_OPERATOR)
1119          .append(')');
1120    } else {
1121      builder
1122          .append(toSQLField(predicate.getKey(), predicate.isMatchCase()))
1123          .append(op)
1124          .append(toSQLValue(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue(), predicate.isMatchCase()));
1125    }
1126  }
1127
1128  public void visitSimplePredicate(SimplePredicate<S> predicate, String op, String value)
1129      throws QueryBuildingException {
1130    if (sqlTermsMapper.includeNullInPredicate(predicate)) {
1131      String column = sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLColumn(term(predicate.getKey()));
1132      builder
1133          .append('(')
1134          .append(toSQLField(predicate.getKey(), predicate.isMatchCase()))
1135          .append(op)
1136          .append(toSQLValue(predicate.getKey(), value, predicate.isMatchCase()))
1137          .append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR)
1138          .append(
1139              isSQLArray(predicate.getKey())
1140                  ? String.format(IS_NOT_NULL_ARRAY_OPERATOR, column)
1141                  : column + IS_NULL_OPERATOR)
1142          .append(')');
1143    } else {
1144      builder
1145          .append(toSQLField(predicate.getKey(), predicate.isMatchCase()))
1146          .append(op)
1147          .append(toSQLValue(predicate.getKey(), value, predicate.isMatchCase()));
1148    }
1149  }

1152  protected boolean isSQLArray(S parameter) {
1153    return sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLType(term(parameter)).startsWith(SQL_ARRAY_PRE);

1161  private void appendHumboldtTaxonFilter(String checklistKey, S parameter, String value) {
1162    Objects.requireNonNull(checklistKey);
1163
1164    String field = HUMBOLDT_TAXON_COLUMNS.getOrDefault(parameter, null);
1165
1166    if (field == null) {
1167      return;
1168    }
1169
1170    builder
1171        .append('(')
1172        .append(
1173            String.format(
1174                "stringArrayContains(%s['%s']['%s'], '%s', true)",
1175                sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(EcoTerm.targetTaxonomicScope),
1176                getChecklistKey(checklistKey),
1177                field,
1178                value))
1179        .append(')');
1180  }
1181
1182  private void appendHumboldtTaxonFilter(EqualsPredicate<S> taxonPredicate) {
1183    appendHumboldtTaxonFilter(
1184        getChecklistKey(taxonPredicate.getChecklistKey()),
1185        taxonPredicate.getKey(),
1186        taxonPredicate.getValue());
1187  }
1188
1189  private void appendHumboldtTaxonFilter(InPredicate<S> taxonPredicate) {
1190    String field = HUMBOLDT_TAXON_COLUMNS.getOrDefault(taxonPredicate.getKey(), null);
1191
1192    if (field == null) {
1193      return;
1194    }
1195
1196    Set<String> taxonKeys =
1197        taxonPredicate.getValues().stream()
1198            .map(v -> toSQLValue(taxonPredicate.getKey(), v, true))
1199            .collect(Collectors.toSet());
1200
1201    builder
1202        .append('(')
1203        .append(
1204            String.format(
1205                "arrays_overlap(%s['%s']['%s'], array(%s))",
1206                sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(EcoTerm.targetTaxonomicScope),
1207                getChecklistKey(taxonPredicate.getChecklistKey()),
1208                field,
1209                formatArray(taxonKeys)))
1210        .append(')');
1211  }

1213  private void appendHumboldtTaxonUnary(String checklistKey, String unaryOperator) {
1214    Objects.requireNonNull(checklistKey);
1215    builder.append('(');
1216    builder.append(
1217        String.format(
1218            "%s['%s']['%s'] " + unaryOperator,
1219            sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(EcoTerm.targetTaxonomicScope),
1220            getChecklistKey(checklistKey),
1221            "usageName"));
1222    builder.append(')');
1223  }

1225  /**
1226   * Searches any of the taxonomic classification keys in Hive of any rank.
1227   *
1228   * @param taxonKeyPredicate to append as filter
1229   */
1230  private void appendTaxonomicArrayFilter(InPredicate<S> taxonKeyPredicate, String sqlField) {
1231    // Using arrays_overlap() instead of EXISTS because it is a standard SQL function
1232    // and may be supported by more SQL engines.
1233    // Also, the expected number of values in the array is small, so performance should be
1234    // acceptable.
1235    builder
1236        .append('(')
1237        .append(
1238            String.format(
1239                "arrays_overlap(%s, array(%s))",
1240                resolveTaxonColumnName(
1241                    sqlField, getChecklistKey(taxonKeyPredicate.getChecklistKey())),
1242                formatArray(taxonKeyPredicate.getValues())))
1243        .append(')');
1244  }
1245
1246  private String formatArray(Collection<String> values) {
1247    return values.stream()
1248        .map(v -> "'" + v.replace("'", "") + "'")
1249        .collect(Collectors.joining(","));
1250  }
1251
1252  private String formatArrayLowerCase(Collection<String> values) {
1253    return values.stream()
1254        .map(v -> "lower('" + v.replace("'", "") + "')")
1255        .collect(Collectors.joining(","));
1256  }

1258  /**
1259   * Searches any of the NUB keys in Hive of any rank.
1260   *
1261   * @param taxonPredicate to append as filter
1262   */
1263  private void appendTaxonomicSingleValueFilter(InPredicate<S> taxonPredicate, String sqlField) {
1264    builder
1265        .append('(')
1266        .append(
1267            String.format(
1268                "%s IN (%s)",
1269                resolveTaxonColumnName(sqlField, taxonPredicate.getChecklistKey()),
1270                formatArray(taxonPredicate.getValues())))
1271        .append(')');
1272  }

1274  /**
1275   * Searches any of the NUB keys in Hive of any rank.
1276   *
1277   * @param taxonPredicate to append as filter
1278   */
1279  private void appendTaxonomicSingleValueFilterCaseInsensitive(
1280      InPredicate<S> taxonPredicate, String sqlField) {
1281    builder
1282        .append('(')
1283        .append(
1284            String.format(
1285                "lower(%s) IN array(%s)",
1286                resolveTaxonColumnName(sqlField, taxonPredicate.getChecklistKey()),
1287                formatArrayLowerCase(taxonPredicate.getValues())))
1288        .append(')');

1291  /** Creates a disjunction of all the given terms. */
1292  private void appendGadmFilterList(List<? extends Term> terms, String value) {
1293    builder
1294        .append('(')
1295        .append(
1296            terms.stream()
1297                .map(
1298                    term ->
1299                        sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term)
1300                            + EQUALS_OPERATOR
1301                            + "'"
1302                            + value
1303                            + "'")
1304                .collect(Collectors.joining(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR)))
1305        .append(')');
1306  }
1307
1308  /**
1309   * Searches any of the NUB keys in Hive of any rank, for multiple keys.
1310   *
1311   * @param taxonomicPredicate to append as filter
1312   */
1313  private void appendTaxonKeyArrayFilter(InPredicate<S> taxonomicPredicate) {
1314
1315    List<String> taxonKeys =
1316        taxonomicPredicate.getValues().stream()
1317            .map(v -> toSQLValue(taxonomicPredicate.getKey(), v, true))
1318            .distinct()
1319            .collect(Collectors.toList());
1320
1321    // if the set is huge, use the lambda EXISTS function
1322    // if not, use the arrays_overlap function
1323    // this is to avoid exposing the EXISTS function to some users (cube),
1324    // which is not a standard SQL function and may not be supported by all SQL engines
1325    if (taxonKeys.size() > lambdaQueryThreshold) {
1326      builder
1327          .append('(')
1328          .append(
1329              String.format(
1330                  // using 'taxonkey' as it needs to be a recognised column
1331                  // to get past calcite validation
1332                  "EXISTS(%s, taxonkey -> taxonkey IN (%s))",
1333                  resolveTaxonColumnName("taxonkeys", taxonomicPredicate.getChecklistKey()),
1334                  formatArray(taxonKeys)))
1335          .append(')');
1336    } else {
1337      builder
1338          .append('(')
1339          .append(
1340              String.format(
1341                  "arrays_overlap(%s, array(%s))",
1342                  resolveTaxonColumnName("taxonkeys", taxonomicPredicate.getChecklistKey()),
1343                  formatArray(taxonKeys)))
1344          .append(')');
1345    }
1346  }
1347
1348  /**
1349   * Searches every level of GADM GID in Hive for multiple keys.
1350   *
1351   * @param gadmGids to append as filter
1352   */
1353  private void appendGadmGidFilter(Collection<String> gadmGids) {
1354    builder.append('(');
1355    boolean first = true;
1356    for (Term term : GADM_GIDS) {
1357      if (!first) {
1358        builder.append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
1359      }
1360      builder.append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term)).append(IN_OPERATOR).append('(');
1361      Iterator<String> iterator = gadmGids.iterator();
1362      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
1363        // Hardcoded GADM_LEVEL_0_GID since the type of all these parameters is the same.
1364        // Using .toUpperCase() is safe, GIDs must be ASCII anyway.
1365        builder.append(
1366            toSQLValue(sqlTermsMapper.getDefaultGadmLevel(), iterator.next().toUpperCase(), true));
1367        if (iterator.hasNext()) {
1368          builder.append(", ");
1369        }
1370      }
1371      builder.append(")");
1372      first = false;
1373    }
1374    builder.append(')');
1375  }
1376
1377  /**
1378   * Searches any of the NUB keys in Hive of any rank.
1379   *
1380   * @param unaryOperator to append as filter
1381   */
1382  private void appendUnaryList(List<? extends Term> terms, String unaryOperator) {
1383    builder.append('(');
1384    builder.append(
1385        terms.stream()
1386            .map(term -> sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term) + unaryOperator)
1387            .collect(Collectors.joining(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR)));
1388    builder.append(')');
1389  }

1391  /**
1392   * Converts decimal range into a predicate with the form: field >= range.lower AND field <=
1393   * range.upper.
1394   */
1395  private Predicate toNumberRangePredicate(Range<Double> range, S key) {
1396    if (!range.hasLowerBound()) {
1397      return new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1398          key, String.valueOf(range.upperEndpoint().doubleValue()));
1399    }
1400    if (!range.hasUpperBound()) {
1401      return new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1402          key, String.valueOf(range.lowerEndpoint().doubleValue()));
1403    }
1404
1405    List<Predicate> predicates =
1406        List.of(
1407            new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1408                key, String.valueOf(range.lowerEndpoint().doubleValue())),
1409            new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1410                key, String.valueOf(range.upperEndpoint().doubleValue())));
1411    return new ConjunctionPredicate(predicates);
1412  }
1413
1414  /**
1415   * Converts integer range into a predicate with the form: field >= range.lower AND field <=
1416   * range.upper.
1417   */
1418  private Predicate toIntegerRangePredicate(Range<Integer> range, S key) {
1419    if (!range.hasLowerBound()) {
1420      return new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1421          key, String.valueOf(range.upperEndpoint().intValue()));
1422    }
1423    if (!range.hasUpperBound()) {
1424      return new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1425          key, String.valueOf(range.lowerEndpoint().intValue()));
1426    }
1427
1428    List<Predicate> predicates =
1429        List.of(
1430            new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1431                key, String.valueOf(range.lowerEndpoint().intValue())),
1432            new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1433                key, String.valueOf(range.upperEndpoint().intValue())));
1434    return new ConjunctionPredicate(predicates);
1435  }
1436
1437  private void visit(Object object) throws QueryBuildingException {
1438    Method method = null;
1439    try {
1440      method = getClass().getMethod("visit", new Class[] {object.getClass()});
1441    } catch (NoSuchMethodException e) {
1442      log.warn(
1443          "Visit method could not be found. That means a unknown Predicate has been passed", e);
1444      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown Predicate", e);
1445    }
1446    try {
1447      method.invoke(this, object);
1448    } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
1449      log.error(
1450          "This error shouldn't occur if all visit methods are public. Probably a programming error",
1451          e);
1452      throw new RuntimeException(e);
1453    } catch (InvocationTargetException e) {
1454      log.info("Exception thrown while building the query", e);
1455      throw new QueryBuildingException(e);
1456    }
1457  }
